A `<section>` element is a landmark/sectioning element, not an interactive control. It doesn't need to be keyboard operable in itself - it's a container. The 2.1.1 obligation applies to interactive controls within it, not the section itself.
The rubric warns against marking things as N/A just because they're out of scope—that's the oracle's job. But I need to think about what "presents as a control" means here. A `<section>` is purely structural, a landmark for organizing content, not something that functions as an interactive widget. Since the section element is a structural container without an interactive role, there's no keyboard operability requirement under 2.1.1, so NOT REPRODUCED is the right call with medium confidence.
